categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Taihe Technologies primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of water treatment chemicals and chlor-alkali products. Its main product lines include scale inhibitors, corrosion inhibitors, biocides, chelating agents, dispersants, reverse osmosis chemicals, and auxiliaries, serving industries such as power, metallurgy, chemical, petroleum, paper, daily chemicals, textile dyeing, and semiconductors. The company also engages in import-export trade and technology services related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced continuous chemical production processes, automation, and intelligent manufacturing systems to produce water treatment chemicals. It holds numerous patents related to continuous synthesis, purification, and process optimization of key products like HEDP, PBTC, ATMP, and others. The production emphasizes energy efficiency, safety, and environmental protection, with integrated AI and digital control systems enabling unmanned operations in major workshops.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Taihe Technologies serves water treatment service providers and trading companies rather than direct end-users. Its products are used in downstream industries including power generation, metallurgy, chemical processing, oil extraction, paper manufacturing, daily chemical products, textile dyeing, and semiconductor manufacturing. The company has a significant domestic and international customer base, with exports accounting for over half of water treatment chemical sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and main production facilities in Zaozhuang, Shandong Province. It has a global market presence, exporting products to multiple countries and regions. Domestic sales account for approximately half of total revenue, with the remainder from international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Taihe Technologies operates mainly in the midstream chemical manufacturing segment, producing water treatment chemicals and chlor-alkali products. It controls upstream raw material production such as phosphorus and chlorinated phosphorus compounds, enabling vertical integration and cost advantages. The company sells primarily to water treatment service providers and distributors downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in water treatment chemical technologies, expanding into high-end electronic chemicals and new energy materials such as lithium battery components. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on process optimization, green and sustainable products, and intelligent manufacturing. Taihe also explores biotechnological synthesis, catalysts, polymers, and agricultural fertilizers to broaden its product portfolio and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of chemical products to water treatment service providers and trading companies. The company operates a self-sales model without intermediaries. Income is derived from product sales domestically and internationally, with no subscription or licensing revenue reported.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Taihe Technologies is one of the largest global producers of water treatment chemicals with a comprehensive product line and strong technological advantages. It holds a leading position in the industry, recognized as a national manufacturing champion and technology innovator. The company competes on scale, quality, cost control, and technological innovation against other domestic and international chemical manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.36 billion, a 6.93% increase over the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 120.6 million, a 14.99% decrease. It has a production capacity of nearly 658,800 tons per year for water treatment chemicals and chlor-alkali products. The company maintains steady growth with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taihe Technologies emphasizes its advanced continuous production technology, comprehensive product portfolio, and strong R&D capabilities as key differentiators. Its vertical integration in raw materials enhances cost competitiveness and supply stability. The company focuses on product quality, environmental sustainability, and intelligent manufacturing to deliver reliable, high-performance water treatment chemicals and specialty products tailored to diverse industrial needs.
